description: Deep multi-agent research for future industry growth and overlooked economic opportunities.

defaultPrompt: Find overlooked industries likely to grow over 5–10 years.
Build a deep economic forecast for a field.

Includes overlooked-opportunity discovery, skeptical review, transparent scoring, and a forecast update workflow. Optional tip jar: [Support on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/quietengine). Tips are entirely optional.
